name: manual_971100
claim: For a 'run this more often' ask, reuse the existing scheduled-task script with a changed interval parameter instead of building new infrastructure -- coord_pulse.ps1 already covered heartbeat, peer probe, and inbox/outbox flush; only install_coord_pulse.ps1's -IntervalSec needed to change from 900 to 60.

decisions.notes: User asked for a 60-second heartbeat + coordination-board + peer-inbox check loop. Reinstalling the existing OramaCoordPulse task at -IntervalSec 60 achieved the outcome with zero new code and a proven-stable script. Verified one live tick completes in ~12s, comfortably inside the 60s window.
